name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) Ration Card

slots.name: has_existing_ration_card
slots.description: Does the family already possess an active ration card?

slots.name: annual_family_income
slots.description: Total annual household income in Indian Rupees.

slots.name: owns_four_wheeler
slots.description: Does anyone in the household own a four-wheeler motor vehicle (excluding tractor)?

slots.name: is_regular_govt_employee
slots.description: Is any household member a regular government employee?

rules.reason: A family can only hold one NFSA ration card. If you already hold one, you can apply only for modification or addition of family members.
Ownership of a four-wheeler motor vehicle disqualifies the household from subsidised NFSA ration card categories.
Families with regular government employees are not eligible under standard priority household criteria.
Annual family income exceeds the standard NFSA poverty threshold limit of ₹1,50,000 per year.

rules.condition: has_existing_ration_card == false and owns_four_wheeler == false and is_regular_govt_employee == false and annual_family_income <= 150000
rules.reason: Your family meets the income criteria and has no disqualifying assets for NFSA Priority Household ration cards.

documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members
Income Certificate / BPL Certificate issued by competent local authority
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill / Water bill / Voter ID)
Passport-size photo of the female head of the family
Bank account passbook of female head of family
next_steps: Submit an online application via your State Food and Civil Supplies portal or visit the local Block Development Office (BDO) / Tehsil Food Supply Inspector.
